title: Inverse image of sheaves of sets along an etale morphism is restriction
statement: Let $j:U\to X$ be an etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism], with small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]; an object $V\to U$ of $U_{\Et}$ gives the object $V\to U\xrightarrow{j}X$ of $X_{\Et}$. For a sheaf of sets $G$ on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] let $G|_U(V\to U)=G(V\to X)$, with the restriction maps of $G$. Let $j^{-1}G$ and $j^*s\in(j^{-1}G)(W\times_XU)$ for $s\in G(W)$, $W$ in $X_{\Et}$, be the etale inverse image of sheaves of sets and the image of $s$ under its unit [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. Then: (1) $G|_U$ is a sheaf of sets on $U_{\Et}$ and there is an isomorphism of sheaves of sets $\rho_G:j^{-1}G\xrightarrow{\sim}G|_U$, natural in $G$; (2) for every object $W$ of $X_{\Et}$ and $s\in G(W)$, $\rho_G(j^*s)=s|_{W\times_XU}\in G(W\times_XU)$, the restriction of $s$ along the projection $W\times_XU\to W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. In particular $\rho_G(U):(j^{-1}G)(U)\xrightarrow{\sim}G(U)$.

proof.text: Use the Mathlib site adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-etale-localization-functor-adjoint], MorphismProperty.Over.mapPullbackAdj, and the continuous-functor instances already provided by the source library. Apply Adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous with coefficients Type (u + 1), as in [lem-weil-pbc-sets-adjoint-continuous-restriction-adjunction], to obtain restriction left adjoint to direct image. Its unit at G and W is definitionally G applied to the opposite of the site counit.

The definition Scheme.etaleSetPullback is the left Kan extension and sheafification construction. Its adjunction to the same continuous direct image is Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-functor-sheaf-pullback-adjunction]. The natural isomorphism rho is Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq applied to these two adjunctions, as in [lem-weil-pbc-sets-adjoint-continuous-restriction-adjunction].

Apply Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app to the two adjunctions and G [lem-weil-pbc-sets-adjoint-continuous-restriction-adjunction]. Apply congrArg with the function sending a sheaf morphism f to f.hom.app (op W) s. Continuous direct image acts on sheaf morphisms by precomposition, and the second unit is definitionally restriction along the site counit; hence the resulting equality is exactly the requested section equation.
